title: Amended S-1: Anthropic says it has purchase commitments and lease agreements of $895.4B, "substantially all of which is related to compute and infrastructure" (Ashley Capoot/CNBC)
commentary: $895 billion in compute commitments before Anthropic has even gone public — that's not a company filing an S-1, that's a company betting civilization-scale money that AI revenue catches up to AI infrastructure costs.
